Linearity: nonlinear for all \(a\) due to the input-independent term \(0.5\cos(2\pi n)\) (zero-input response not zero); if that term is treated as a fixed input, the input–output map is linear. Stability: BIBO stable iff \(|a|<1\); unstable for \(|a|\ge 1\). Causality: causal for all \(a\in\mathbb{R}\). Time-invariance: time-invariant for all \(a\in\mathbb{R}\) (the cosine term is periodic with period 1, hence invariant to integer shifts). Memorylessness: not memoryless for any \(a\) (output depends on \(y[n-3]\)).
\(G(z)=\frac{1-z^{-2}}{1+\frac12 z^{-2}}\), causal and stable (poles at \(z=\pm j/\sqrt{2}\), inside unit circle).
